title: THE FORGE: THE UNDERCROFT SHOWS IT
why: His rule of 2026-10-12: an upgraded gun you extract with is yours to keep. The Undercroft now shows it: the stash and backpack hover of the gun leads with UPGRADE (MK II or MK III) and ELEMENT and gives the upgraded numbers, the belt and the sector page call it Auto Rifle MK III, and its icon glows gold for MK II or in the element colour for MK III, with a small element dot. In a raid the backpack hover reads the gun you are carrying the same way.
now: The Undercroft shows your upgraded guns by name, colour and numbers.
